suggested_requirements.text: The system shall generate unique voucher numbers with in-built security protocols.
The system shall print voucher codes in bar-code format.
The system shall allow authorized users to amend the validity date of vouchers.
The system shall capture master details of distributors including code, name, address, and business type.
The system shall allow users to view the sales history of a specific distributor.
The system shall capture details of MSIU salesmen including code, name, and assigned sales team.
The system shall record voucher distribution transactions between the MSIU sales team and distributors.
The system shall automatically calculate invoice amounts based on the number of vouchers sold and the wholesale price.
The system shall capture VSP (Voucher Service Provider) master information including contact details, facility level, and payment terms.
The system shall automatically inactivate a VSP if more than two fraud entries are detected during the claim process.
The system shall capture VSP staff details including staff code, name, and type.
The system shall record claim submissions from VSPs including the number of forms and treatment details.
The system shall generate a receipt document upon claim submission.
The system shall validate claim data against mandatory fields before saving to the database.
The system shall store claims with missing or false information in a quarantine area.
The system shall calculate claim amounts based on consultation fees, lab fees, and drug costs.
The system shall compare thumb-print impressions on claims with previous visits for the same voucher number.
The system shall record voucher sales returns from distributors.
The system shall capture client feedback including treatment satisfaction and counseling quality.
The system shall generate standard and customized medical, financial, and statistical reports.
The system shall manage user access privileges based on user groups and screen-level permissions.
The system shall use drop-down selection menus for transaction screens to minimize data entry errors.
The system shall minimize keyboard usage for number entry to facilitate faster transaction data entry.
The database storage shall be highly efficient to manage and avoid empty unused space.
The system shall implement high intrusion controls for the system and the database.
The system shall interface with a thumb-print reader for verifying client claim forms.
The system shall interface with a bar-code reader for transaction details and voucher verification.
The system shall have provision to expand beyond the pilot period.
The system shall be developed on the Oracle 9i platform using Visual Basic for the front end and Crystal Reports 9 for reporting.
